experiment_data.hypothesis: Frozen dt_emb (random init, no gradients) + learned gate WITHOUT curriculum (phase1=0, phase2=0, gate fully unlocked from step 0). Tests whether frozen dt_emb prevents CIVO (NVE < 1.5×) while allowing the gate to learn meaningful temporal abstraction (gate_dt_1_frac < 1.0). exp_022 was inconclusive because curriculum locked gate for the entire run; this rerun removes that confound.

spec.command: bash -c "unset CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/event-gated-adaptive-horizon && MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=1 LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6 MUJOCO_GL=egl python -u dreamer.py --configs dmc_proprio --task dmc_walker_walk --steps 105000 --seed 0 --device cuda:1 --compile False --checkpoint_every 10000 --gate_enabled True --gate_dt_embed_dim 32 --dt_emb_freeze True --gate_subsample_min_dt 1 --gate_subsample_max_dt 2 --gate_curriculum_phase1 0 --gate_curriculum_phase2 0 --imag_horizon 8 --logdir ./logdir/exp_022b_no_curriculum"
